sources.title: Ernst Grob Metal Spinning
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 管件液壓成形
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：正弦律只附有剪旋壓假設使用，角度基準及厚度量測方向可重現。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the sine law only with its shear-spinning assumptions and reproducible angle/thickness directions.
related.difference: 由自由體圖推導環向應力，辨認圓管薄壁模型何時不能代表成形圓角。
related.differenceEn: Derive hoop stress and identify why a thin circular-tube model cannot represent all forming corners.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想剪旋壓薄錐 t=t0 sinα，其中 α 是錐壁與旋轉軸夾角；需特定材料流動假設。 合成初厚 2.0 mm，錐半角 30°，忽略回彈與局部不均。 t=2sin30°=1.0 mm；以與底面夾角 60°代入會誤得 1.732 mm。
封閉薄壁圓管的環向應力 σθ=pD/(2t)；此處只作彈性受力尺度，不能當成成形壓力配方。 純教學 p=1 MPa、中徑 D=40 mm、厚度 t=1 mm；忽略端部與接觸。 σθ=1×40/(2×1)=20 MPa；D/t=40，仍須檢查薄壁假設與局部曲率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For ideal shear spinning t=t 0 sin α, with α between wall and rotation axis; it requires a specific flow idealization. Synthetic initial thickness 2.0 mm, half-angle 30°; neglect springback and local nonuniformity. t=2 sin 30°=1.0 mm; substituting the complementary 60° angle incorrectly gives 1.732 mm.

For a thin circular tube σθ=pD/(2 t); use it only as a stress scale, not a hydroforming-pressure recipe. Teaching p=1 MPa, mean diameter 40 mm, wall 1 mm; omit end and contact effects. σθ=1×40/(2×1)=20 MPa; D/t=40, with thin-wall and local-curvature assumptions still explicit.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工業減速機裝配
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：正弦律只附有剪旋壓假設使用，角度基準及厚度量測方向可重現。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the sine law only with its shear-spinning assumptions and reproducible angle/thickness directions.
related.difference: 逐級追蹤減速比與效率，避免把減速當成能量增加。
related.differenceEn: Track ratio and efficiency stage by stage without treating reduction as an energy gain.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想剪旋壓薄錐 t=t0 sinα，其中 α 是錐壁與旋轉軸夾角；需特定材料流動假設。 合成初厚 2.0 mm，錐半角 30°，忽略回彈與局部不均。 t=2sin30°=1.0 mm；以與底面夾角 60°代入會誤得 1.732 mm。
總比i=i1i2，n_out=n_in/i，T_out=T_in iη1η2；齒輪效率需相乘。 教學i1=3、i2=4，各級η=0.95，輸入1200 rpm與10 N·m。 總比12，輸出100 rpm，總η0.9025，T_out=108.3 N·m；輸出功率為輸入的90.25%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For ideal shear spinning t=t 0 sin α, with α between wall and rotation axis; it requires a specific flow idealization. Synthetic initial thickness 2.0 mm, half-angle 30°; neglect springback and local nonuniformity. t=2 sin 30°=1.0 mm; substituting the complementary 60° angle incorrectly gives 1.732 mm.

Total ratio i=i 1 i 2, output speed=n_in/i and torque=T_in i η1 η2; efficiencies multiply. Teaching ratios 3 and 4, each efficiency 0.95, input 1200 rpm and 10 N·m. Total ratio 12, output 100 rpm, efficiency 0.9025 and torque 108.3 N·m; output power is 90.25% of input.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
